import io
import json


def json_to_csv(json_text):
    rows = json.loads(json_text)
    if not rows:
        return ""
    out = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(out)
    header = list(rows[0])
    writer.writerow(header)
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow([row[k] for k in header])
    return out.getvalue()
